title: Seek machine state transition
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $d$ be a configuration of the record machine, let $rank<3^{k+1}$, and let $b$ be a Boolean. Suppose $d$ is in the record machine's initial state and the symbol under the summary-tape head is $b$. If $b$ is true, one step of the seek machine advances the summary head by one and enters a request control carrying $rank$, the index $3^{k+1}-1$, and the flag false. If $b$ is false, it leaves the configuration's tapes and head positions unchanged and enters the done control when $rank=0$, or a request control carrying $rank$, $rank-1$, and the flag true otherwise.

the symbol under the summary-tape head is $b$
